prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
One swing gave Hanshin the lead. The rest of the night was about protecting it and making it bigger.

On August 16, 2026, at Mazda Stadium, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field in the first inning. Hanshin quickly took the lead over Hiroshima.

Hiroshima scored once in the fifth inning, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run. It was Hiroshima’s only run of the game.

Hanshin’s starting pitcher, Rihito Ihara, gave his team a strong foundation. He worked five innings, allowed only two hits, and gave up one run. That kept Hanshin in front while the game was still close.

Hanshin then added runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The early home run had started the night well, but the later scoring created a much wider gap.

Hanshin finished with an 8-1 win over Hiroshima. The early lead was protected and then extended until the result was clear.

【Point One】
After five innings, Hanshin led only 2-1. Sato’s early two-run homer had been followed by Montero’s solo shot. The real separation came later, when Hanshin scored in the seventh and eighth. The opening swing created control, but the late runs turned a close game into a decisive win.

【Point Two】
Hanshin’s scoring came from several players. Sato provided the two-run homer, while Seishiro Sakamoto and Taira Fushimi later added RBI hits. Hiroshima had only Montero’s solo homer. That contrast shows the difference between Hanshin’s continuing attack and Hiroshima’s single scoring play.
